curvature_maps — 3D feature op

• Data kinds: voxel → curvature

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.curvature_maps(vol, device='cpu', mc=0.000625) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.curvature_maps(vol, device='cpu', mc=0.000625); from the registry, ops3d.get("curvature_maps"))

• GPU: this op has a GPU path (device="cuda")

Usage

Principal curvatures of a level set → the shape index S (Koenderink) and curvedness. Closed form (Kindlmann 2003).

Line→surface lift of the 2D contour curvature (1 scalar): a surface has 2 principal curvatures κ1,κ2. mean = (κ1+κ2)/2 = (|g|²trH − gᵀHg)/|g|³, Gauss K = κ1κ2 = gᵀadj(H)g/|g|⁴ (g=∇, H=Hessian). S=(2/π)atan2(κ1+κ2, κ1−κ2) ∈[-1,1] is a local surface type invariant to intensity and rotation (cup−1/rut/saddle0/ ridge+.5/cap+1). Under the outward-normal convention, a bright convex blob = cap(+1). Returns (S, curvedness, mask, |g|), all torch.

Units: the separable-conv gain 32 of sobel3d (deriv[-1,0,1]×smoothing[1,2,1]²) is divided back out here, so κ1,κ2/curvedness are in true 1/voxel units (curvedness=1/R on a spherical shell of radius R), and |g| and the mask threshold mc are in true gradient units per voxel. The old version (up to 2026-08-29) forgot to divide back:

curvedness was 1/32 times and mc was in raw sobel3d units (the shape index S is a ratio and unaffected). If you used old mc values, pass them multiplied by 1/32 (the default 0.02→6.25e-4 has also been converted equivalently).
